result.stdout:
Assay -- .NET code analysis for AI agents

Usage: assay <command> [arguments] [options]

Run 'assay help <command>' (or 'assay <command> --help') for a command's arguments, options, and defaults.

Commands:
  overview  <solution>                              Show solution overview
  health    <solution>                              Show health dashboard
  search    <solution> <query>                      Search for types, files, and entities
  deps      <solution>                              Show project dependency structure: attention items, layers, diagram, hubs
  project   summary      <solution> <project>       Show project summary
  project   deps         <solution> <project>       Show what a project depends on and what depends on it
  project   namespaces   <solution> <project>       List namespaces in a project
  project   assemblies   <solution> <project>       List assembly references
  project   diagnostics  <solution> <project>       Show project diagnostics
  type      detail       <solution> <type>          Show type detail
  type      rels         <solution> <type>          Show type relationships
  type      hierarchy    <solution> <type>          Show type inheritance hierarchy
  type      context      <solution> <type>          Get full context bundle for a type
  type      usages       <solution> <type>          Show where a type is used
  type      decompile    <solution> <type>          Decompile an external/NuGet type to C# source
  member    <solution> <member>                     Show member detail with callers and callees
  impact    <solution> <subject>                    Analyze impact of changing an entity (type or member)
  assembly  <solution> <assembly>                   Show assembly detail
  namespace <solution> <namespace>                  Show namespace summary
  path      <solution> <from> <to>                  Find dependency path between entities
  batch     <solution> <query>...                   Run several quoted queries against one loaded graph (one invocation)
  churn  
[truncated]

DESCRIPTION:
Show namespace summary

USAGE:
    assay namespace [solution] [namespace] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    [solution]     Path to a .sln/.slnx file (auto-detected if omitted)
    [namespace]    Namespace to summarize                              

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help               Prints help information                                                                    
        --json               Output as JSON instead of structured markdown                                              
        --no-cache           Force re-analysis: bypass the graph cache, ignore cached coverage runs, and skip importing 
                             existing Cobertura reports                                                                 
        --verbose            Show progress and diagnostic output on stderr                                              
        --lightweight        Use structural-only analysis (fast, no Roslyn)                                             
        --nested             Include nested namespaces                                                                  
        --max <N>            Maximum types shown (default: 50)                                                          
        --coverage <PATH>    Use an existing coverage report (file or glob), or 'auto' to collect                       
        --no-coverage        Skip coverage entirely: no collection, no report discovery (output shows n/a)

DESCRIPTION:
Rank CRAP findings by churn-weighted volatility

USAGE:
    assay volatility [solution] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    [solution]    Path to a .sln/.slnx file (auto-detected if omitted)

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                     Prints help information                                                              
        --json                     Output as JSON instead of structured markdown                                        
        --no-cache                 Force re-analysis: bypass the graph cache, ignore cached coverage runs, and skip     
                                   importing existing Cobertura reports                                                 
        --verbose                  Show progress and diagnostic output on stderr                                        
        --lightweight              Use structural-only analysis (fast, no Roslyn)                                       
        --threshold <N>            CRAP score threshold (default: 30)                                                   
        --top <N>                  Top N results (default: 20)                                                          
        --days <N>                 Lookback period in days (default: 90)                                                
        --sort <K>                 Sort key: crap, volatility, combined (default: combined)                             
        --scope <PROJECT>          Scope to a project                                                                   
        --coverage <PATH>          Use an existing coverage report (file or glob), or 'auto' to collect                 
        --no-coverage              Skip coverage entirely: no collection, no report discovery (output shows n/a)        
        --coverage-build <MODE>    Where 'dotnet test' builds when collecting coverage: isolated (default, under the    
                                   assay cache) or in-place (reuse the repository's own build output); overrides

DESCRIPTION:
Run all analyses and prioritize findings

USAGE:
    assay kitchensink [solution] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    [solution]    Path to a .sln/.slnx file (auto-detected if omitted)

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                     Prints help information                                                              
        --json                     Output as JSON instead of structured markdown                                        
        --no-cache                 Force re-analysis: bypass the graph cache, ignore cached coverage runs, and skip     
                                   importing existing Cobertura reports                                                 
        --verbose                  Show progress and diagnostic output on stderr                                        
        --lightweight              Use structural-only analysis (fast, no Roslyn)                                       
        --top <N>                  Top N findings per category (default: 5)                                             
        --severity <S>             Minimum severity to include (critical, high, medium, low) (default: low)             
        --skip <C>                 Skip a category (repeatable): vulnerability, license, crap, coveragegap, diagnostic, 
                                   churn                                                                                
        --fail-on <S>              Exit with code 2 if any finding is at or above this severity (critical, high, medium,
                                   low)                                                                                 
        --output <DIR>             Write a markdown+HTML report bundle to a directory                                   
        --exclude-path <GLOB>      Exclude paths matching a glob (repeatable)                                           
        --include-generated        Include code-generated members (excluded by default)                                 
        --coverage <PATH>

DESCRIPTION:
Inspect, manage, export and import the assay cache

USAGE:
    assay cache <COMMAND>

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    path      Print the resolved cache root directory                                             
    info      Show cache contents and sizes                                                       
    clear     Delete all cached graphs, package analyses, and vulnerability scans (requires --yes)
    prune     Remove stale or orphaned graph caches                                               
    export    Pack a solution's graph cache entry into a commit-addressed snapshot archive (ZIP)  
    import    Restore a snapshot archive as the graph cache entry of a solution (this checkout)

        --max-subjects <N>    Maximum reached subjects in the markdown table (default: unlimited, 15 with --summary);
